description: Public collection of high-quality templates created by General Legal attorneys with CC0 license
summary: Attorney-drafted startup contracts in CC0 markdown with `<mark>`-tagged fill-in fields is exactly the kind of boring infrastructure I wish I'd had when I was shipping Oh Tidepool and needed a privacy policy without a $2,000 invoice. The LLM-optimized format is a small but real engineering choice: the field markers give a model a clean, unambiguous contract to fill, and the per-template READMEs explain scope and key provisions well enough that I can actually sanity-check the output before it goes live. The BAA template is a nice nod to anyone, like me, who keeps a bioinformatics thread running through their product work.
